kind: semantic contract; atomic authority transition is a specification oracle, not implemented service or qualified SMB adapter

operations.acquire: atomically admit one session; verify CatalogId, protocol and committed payload; never infer permission from expired heartbeat
operations.validate: verify identity, generation, payload integrity/hash and current admission before enabling writes
operations.openLocal: verified standalone snapshot becomes local WAL; Preview stays separate
operations.publish: snapshot locally; transfer unique candidate; verify; atomically require current owner epoch and exact expected parent at promotion; reject stale token/base
operations.acknowledge: record exact publication/generation identity; lost acknowledgement reconciles by identity, never blind retry
operations.heartbeat: diagnostic liveness only; no authority to take over
operations.release: drain dirty boundary, final verified publication, durable release; failed publication retains recovery state
operations.recover: preserve local DB/WAL; unknown dirty state means recovery; missing/corrupt current blocks automatic open; explicit verified previous recovery creates a new generation
operations.takeover: explicit abandoned-work warning and confirmation plus server-enforced invalidation/serialized successor; timeout or confirmation alone insufficient

protected_reads: local review may continue with visibly stale central-save status; no mutation side effects
fencing_adapter: unresolved for pure SMB; recommend minimal central authority/publication service, not implemented
invariants: at most one admitted authoring session
acknowledged generation never silently rolls back
duplicate publication id is idempotent only for matching request
